message.content: A typical **medium-sized fresh tomato** (about 123 grams) contains roughly **20–23 kcal**—so around **21 kilocalories** on average. If you’re looking at smaller tomatoes (≈90 g), they’ll be closer to **15–16 kcal**, whereas larger ones (≈150 g) will hit the upper end of the 24‑26 kcal range.
